contact.faq0q: How long does a Caste Certificate take?
contact.faq0a: Caste Certificates are typically processed within 24–48 hours of submission. You will receive an SMS and in-app notification once approved.
contact.faq1q: What documents are required for a Pension application?
contact.faq1a: You will need: Aadhaar card, age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), bank passbook (first page), income certificate, and a passport-sized photograph. Documents can be uploaded digitally during the application.
contact.faq2q: Can I apply for multiple services simultaneously?
contact.faq2a: Yes. Each service application is tracked independently with its own application number. You can submit multiple applications at the same time and track each one separately from your dashboard.
contact.faq3q: How do I update my family member details?
contact.faq3a: Go to My Family in the navigation menu. From there you can view all registered family members and submit a change request. Changes are verified by the Talati office within 3–5 working days.
contact.faq4q: What if my application is rejected?
contact.faq4a: You have the right to appeal within 30 days of rejection. Go to My Applications, open the rejected application, and click "Raise Grievance". The grievance will be reviewed by a senior officer.
contact.faq5q: Is my data safe on Digital Gujarat?

consents.right0title: Right to know what data the Government holds about you
consents.right0body: You can request a full list of personal data held by any government department. Use the "Download My Data" feature below to get a complete copy.
consents.right1body: If any data on record is incorrect, you can raise a correction request through the My Data tab. The concerned department must respond within 30 days.
consents.right2body: You may request deletion of your data where it is no longer necessary. Active scheme enrolments and legally mandated records are excluded from erasure.
consents.right3title: Right to grievance redressal within 30 days
consents.right3body: Any complaint related to data processing must be addressed by the Data Fiduciary within 30 days. You can escalate to the Data Protection Board if unresolved.
consents.right4body: You may nominate a trusted family member to exercise your data rights on your behalf in the event of incapacity.
